text:
Asha Nair: quick ask — can someone cover the ML infra panel next Wed 3:00pm PT? candidate has coding + systems design. also need final rubric weights before debrief (i'm out thursday)
Rafael Gomez: i can take it if no one else — 3pm PT works for me. happy to do note-taking too :memo:
Maya Chen: putting a +1 on rafael, but heads-up candidate prefers live coding first. do we want to shift weight towards coding?
Asha Nair: thanks rafael! re weights i was thinking: system design 50, coding 35, collaboration/culture 15. open to adjust if we expect heavy alg work.
Evan Brooks: i vote 40/40/20 for this role — infra candidate needs solid implementation.
Li Zhang: i lean toward Evan's split. also can confirm interview doc link and debrief owner?
Asha Nair: debrief doc: https://docs.internal/recruiting/ml-infra-2026 (please open before). debrief owner = Rafael unless he opts out.
Rafael Gomez: i'll own debrief + notes. quick Q: do we want score rubrics numeric 1-5 or rubric buckets (clear/needs work)?
Maya Chen: numeric 1-5 + short comment for each section is best for comparisons.
interview-bot: Reminder: panel reminder scheduled for 2026-03-25 22:00 UTC. For swaps, reply with `swap:` and person name.
Evan Brooks: swap: i have a client call at 3:15 PT, can we swap my slot to first half of panel?
Rafael Gomez: noted — Evan, want me to take the live coding block while you do system design? we can split 30/30.
Evan Brooks: yes please, that works. i'll pick up system design and culture. thanks rafael.
Asha Nair: updated weights -> 40 system design, 40 coding, 20 culture. Rafael = debrief owner. Evan + Maya confirm note fields: "score 1-5", "top risks", "recommendation"
Maya Chen: confirmed. i'll prepare two starter prompts for live coding (30min) and share in thread later today.
Rafael Gomez: thanks everyone — i'll create the debrief doc template and post link in the calendar invite. :thumbsup:
Asha Nair: perfect. if anyone needs the candidate resume or timeline, ping me here.
